verdict.rationale: Mercury documents its own card limits and spend controls, and its API can manage spending limits on virtual cards. Cards can be created for specific purposes such as ad spend or contractors, and a long-time customer confirms running hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. However, the evidence shows only per-card limits, not a department- or program-level budget that aggregates and enforces spend across cards or users. Missing for 10: a documented department/program budget object, budget-level enforcement across multiple cards or users, and budget tracking/reporting against limits.
